navamsha_spouse_rules.description: D9 Navamsha spouse prediction rules from BPHS and Jaimini Sutras

d9_7th_lord_in_sign.interpretation: Spouse is assertive, independent, and pioneering. Quick to act, with leadership qualities. May have a reddish complexion or athletic build.
Spouse is stable, sensual, and beauty-loving. Values material comfort and security. Attractive appearance with pleasant features.
Spouse is communicative, witty, and intellectually versatile. Youthful appearance with expressive eyes. May have dual interests.
Spouse is nurturing, emotional, and family-oriented. Round face, caring disposition. Deeply attached to home and family.
Spouse is regal, generous, and dignified. Commanding presence with warm personality. Desires admiration and respect in marriage.
Spouse is practical, health-conscious, and detail-oriented. Neat appearance with analytical mind. Service-oriented and perfectionist.
Spouse is diplomatic, charming, and aesthetically inclined. Attractive and well-balanced personality. Values harmony in relationships.
Spouse is intense, passionate, and deeply loyal. Magnetic personality with penetrating eyes. Secretive nature with transformative influence.
Spouse is philosophical, optimistic, and freedom-loving. Tall or well-built with generous disposition. Values higher learning and travel.
Spouse is mature, responsible, and ambitious. Structured approach to life with disciplined habits. May appear older or serious.
Spouse is unconventional, humanitarian, and intellectually independent. Unique appearance or style. Values friendship in marriage.
Spouse is compassionate, spiritual, and intuitive. Dreamy eyes with gentle demeanor. Artistic and selfless in love.

venus_in_d9_sign.interpretation: Wife is energetic, bold, and passionate. Quick to express love. Athletic build, possibly sharp features. Reddish or warm complexion.
Wife is beautiful, graceful, and loves luxury. Venus in own sign gives an attractive, fair-complexioned spouse with artistic taste.
Wife is communicative, witty, and youthful looking. Slim build with expressive features. Intellectually stimulating companion.
Wife is nurturing, emotionally warm, with a round face. Fair or pale complexion. Devoted to family and home. Excellent cook.
Wife has a regal bearing, warm and generous. Prominent hair, confident gait. Loves to be admired and attracts attention naturally.
Wife is modest, neat, and health-conscious. Venus debilitated here gives a practical but less romantic spouse. Detail-oriented nature.
Wife is exceptionally beautiful, charming, and socially graceful. Venus in own sign gives balanced features and artistic temperament.
Wife is intensely attractive, magnetic, and passionate. Deep penetrating eyes. Secretive nature with strong sensuality.
Wife is tall, well-built, and optimistic. Freedom-loving with philosophical nature. Athletic appearance, enjoys outdoor activities.
Wife is mature-looking, serious, and disciplined. May appear older than actual age. Slim build with structured features.
Wife has unique or unconventional appearance. Tall with distinctive features. Independent thinker with humanitarian interests.
Wife is dreamy, beautiful with large expressive eyes. Venus exalted here gives a compassionate, spiritual, and artistically gifted spouse.

jupiter_in_d9_sign.interpretation: Husband is assertive, confident, and pioneering. Strong build with commanding presence. Natural leader with protective instincts.
Husband is stable, wealthy, and comfort-loving. Solid build with pleasant face. Values material security and family traditions.
Husband is intellectual, communicative, and versatile. Medium build with youthful appearance. Enjoys learning and social interaction.
Husband is nurturing, emotionally wise, and protective. Jupiter exalted here gives a deeply caring, prosperous, and spiritual spouse.
Husband is dignified, generous, and authoritative. Tall with commanding presence. Natural leader with noble character.
Husband is analytical, health-conscious, and service-oriented. Medium build with intelligent features. Practical and methodical nature.
Husband is balanced, diplomatic, and socially graceful. Handsome with refined manners. Values justice and harmony in relationships.
Husband is intense, deeply insightful, and transformative. Magnetic presence with piercing gaze. May be involved in research or occult.
Husband is wise, philosophical, and generous. Jupiter in own sign gives a tall, well-built, dharmic, and spiritually inclined spouse.
Husband is serious, ambitious, and disciplined. Jupiter debilitated here may give a less religious or materialistic spouse. Thin build.
Husband is innovative, humanitarian, and unconventional. Tall with distinctive features. Progressive thinker with scientific mind.
Husband is spiritual, compassionate, and artistic. Jupiter in own sign gives a wise, generous, and spiritually evolved spouse.

d9_lagna_in_sign.interpretation: Dynamic and passionate marriage. Both partners are independent. Quick engagement but possible conflicts from ego. Marriage brings energy and initiative.
Stable and comfortable marriage. Partners value security and sensual pleasures. Wealth accumulates after marriage. Strong physical bond.
Intellectually stimulating marriage. Communication is central. May have dual nature in partnerships. Friendship-based relationship.
Emotionally deep marriage. Home and family are priorities. Strong nurturing bond. Possible mood swings affecting relationship.
Royal and dignified marriage. Both partners seek recognition. Generous and warm relationship. Children bring joy.
Practical and service-oriented marriage. Focus on health and daily routines. May lack romance but strong in devotion and duty.
Harmonious and balanced marriage. Beauty and aesthetics play a role. Strong partnership with mutual respect. Social life is important.
Intense and transformative marriage. Deep emotional and physical connection. Power dynamics may be challenging. Loyalty is paramount.
Philosophical and freedom-loving marriage. Partners share spiritual interests. Long-distance or cross-cultural marriage possible.
Structured and serious marriage. Partners are ambitious and goal-oriented. Delayed marriage possible but long-lasting once established.
Unconventional marriage. Partners value intellectual freedom. Friendship is the basis of the relationship. May have unusual living arrangements.
Spiritual and compassionate marriage. Deep soul connection with partner. Artistic and romantic relationship. Possible idealization of spouse.

planet_in_d9_7th.interpretation: Spouse is authoritative, proud, and status-conscious. Government or leadership career for spouse. Ego clashes possible in marriage.
Spouse is emotional, nurturing, and changeable. Public-facing career for spouse. Strong emotional bond in marriage. May have mood fluctuations.
Spouse is energetic, courageous, and possibly aggressive. Technical or military career. Passionate marriage with potential for conflicts.
Spouse is intelligent, communicative, and business-minded. Young appearance. Marriage based on intellectual connection and friendship.
Spouse is wise, religious, and prosperous. Teaching or advisory career. Blessed marriage with dharmic foundation. Generous partner.
Spouse is beautiful, artistic, and pleasure-loving. Creative or luxury industry career. Romantic and harmonious marriage. Physical attraction strong.
Spouse is serious, mature, and hardworking. Delayed marriage possible. Older spouse or one with heavy responsibilities. Enduring bond.
Spouse is unconventional, foreign, or from different background. May involve inter-caste or cross-cultural marriage. Unusual circumstances around marriage.
Spouse is spiritual, detached, or reclusive. Past-life karmic connection with partner. Spiritual bond but may lack material focus.

upapada_cross_reference.interpretation: Upapada in Aries: Spouse is assertive and independent. Marriage happens quickly. Partner from military, sports, or competitive fields.
Upapada in Taurus: Spouse is wealthy and beautiful. Venus-ruled sign indicates comfort and luxury in marriage. Stable relationship.
Upapada in Gemini: Spouse is communicative and intellectual. May meet through education or media. Dual nature possible in relationships.
Upapada in Cancer: Spouse is nurturing and family-oriented. Emotional bond is strong. Marriage brings domestic happiness.
Upapada in Leo: Spouse is proud and dignified. Partner may be from royal, political, or entertainment background. Generous marriage.
Upapada in Virgo: Spouse is practical and service-oriented. Marriage based on duty and shared responsibilities. Health-conscious partner.
Upapada in Libra: Spouse is attractive and diplomatic. Marriage is harmonious with mutual respect. Partner from artistic or legal background.
Upapada in Scorpio: Spouse is intense and secretive. Deep karmic connection. Marriage involves transformation. Partner from research or occult fields.
Upapada in Sagittarius: Spouse is philosophical and freedom-loving. Partner from teaching, law, or religious background. Cross-cultural marriage possible.
Upapada in Capricorn: Spouse is ambitious and disciplined. Delayed marriage but enduring. Partner from business or government background.
Upapada in Aquarius: Spouse is unconventional and humanitarian. Unique marriage circumstances. Partner from technology or social work background.
Upapada in Pisces: Spouse is spiritual and compassionate. Deep soul connection. Partner from artistic, healing, or spiritual background.
